null.provenance: IMPORTED, not measured. Section 3: no same-request null has been measured on SLURP, so the admission clause uses zero as the null and adds a margin of 0.60 pp, section 4.1's own figure, taken from the Earnings-22 null's half-width on the same scale. A result inside that margin is NOT ADMITTED and NOT REFUTED, and measuring this carrier's own null becomes the named next cell rather than a footnote.

rule_4_1_verbatim: ADMITTED as a model-usage local optimization iff all three hold: (1) Intent accuracy (scenario+action), the paper-facing headline. The CI90 lower bound on the delta is > +0.60 pp -- above zero and above the imported null margin. Point estimate positive. (2) SLU-F1 does not worsen. Its CI90 lower bound is above -0.60 pp (non-inferiority at the same imported margin), and scenario and action accuracy are both non-inferior on the same rule. (3) No stratum is harmed beyond the carrier's own rule. SLURP's per-scenario harm bound, as EVO-S1 already uses it: no scenario loses more than 3.0 pp of intent accuracy, and at most 2 of the 18 scenarios lose anything at all.
